title: LOGOS ASF — Operator Review Decision
description: Schema for all operator review decisions made against TR-01 improvement candidates. Every decision is attributable, timestamped, hashed, and append-only. No decision promotes, deploys, or trains anything automatically.

decision_id.description: Unique deterministic ID derived from candidate_id, action, operator_id, and timestamp. Format: RD-YYYYMMDD-<sha256[:8]>.

candidate_id.description: The TR-01 candidate this decision applies to.

candidate_version.description: Which version of the candidate this decision applies to. Version 1 is the original TR-01 output. Redact/rewrite increments to v2, v3, etc.

operator_id.description: Identifier of the operator making the decision. Must not be empty.

operator_role.description: Role of the operator making the decision. Must not be empty.

reason.description: Operator-provided reason for this decision. Required for all actions.

evidence_reviewed.description: Operator attests that all source evidence was reviewed before making this decision.

redactions.description: Log of fields redacted in this decision. Empty for non-redact actions.

rewritten_fields.description: Log of fields rewritten in this decision. Empty for non-rewrite actions.

previous_lane.description: Original lane before reclassification. Null for non-reclassify actions.

new_lane.description: Target lane for reclassification. Null for non-reclassify actions.

source_candidate_ids.description: For merge: all candidate IDs being merged. Empty for other actions.

resulting_status.description: The candidate's new promotion_status after this decision. Approve uses the lane-specific pending state; no action produces a final training dataset or deployment.

training_allowed.description: Always false. No decision authorizes training.

store1_write_allowed.description: Always false. No decision authorizes Store 1 writes.

runtime_deployment_allowed.description: Always false. No decision authorizes runtime deployment.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of the decision in ISO 8601 format.

queue_version.description: Review queue tool version. Format: review_queue:<version>.

decision_hash.description: SHA-256 of the full decision record minus this field (sort_keys=True, compact JSON). Provides tamper detection for the append-only log.

x-invariants.no_auto_promotion: No action in this schema promotes a candidate to a training dataset, deployed skill, tool, evaluator, or model.
x-invariants.training_allowed_const_false: training_allowed is const:false. No operator decision may authorize training.
x-invariants.append_only_log: The decisions.jsonl file is append-only. No decision modifies or deletes prior decisions.
x-invariants.original_immutable: Original TR-01 candidate files are never modified by any action.
x-invariants.hash_verified_on_load: Every decision record is hash-verified on load. Tampered records cause immediate abort.
